Translucent, immaterial serpent formed of Limbo's energy. Thrives on mischief.

AC 13, HP 25, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d8) or possession or warpwave, MV near (fly), S -4, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +3, AL C, LV 5

Being of Chaos. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. Immune to acid.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.

Possession. Must be corporeal. One target, close range. Contested CHA check. If ghost wins, it inhabits target's body and controls it for 2d4 rounds.

Warpwave. All beings within near of protean (including protean), CHA 15+ or take 1d8 attribute damage. d6: 1. STR, 2. DEX, 3. CON, 4. INT, 5. WIS, 6. CHA.
